Orchestrator-worker research agents beat single-agent by 90.2% at ~15x tokens; a single LLM-as-a-judge call scoring 0.0-1.0 on factual accuracy, citation accuracy, completeness and tool efficiency was most consistent; a dedicated citation pass and full production tracing were required.
Tool design principles: a few consolidated tools, namespacing, high-signal responses, token-efficient pagination, and 'describe your tool as you would to a new hire', iterated with evaluations.

Agent Skills are SKILL.md directories loaded by progressive disclosure (metadata first, body on demand) and must be audited for bundled code and network calls before install; spec opened as a standard 2025-12-18 per search results.
Long-running agents need fresh-context sessions handing off through structured artifacts (progress file, feature list, git history), one feature at a time, and end-to-end testing before new work.
Prompt caching cuts cost up to 90% and latency up to 85% for long stable prefixes such as agent instructions, documents and multi-turn tool use.
Claude for Government (FedRAMP High) ships hash-chained audit logs for admin actions, department-level admin boundaries, and hard spending caps tied to appropriated funds.

Dated enterprise defense summary: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2025-12), OpenAI Lockdown Mode (2026-02-13), Claude Opus 4.5 indirect-injection success 4.7% at one attempt and 33.6% at ten; all three labs say defense in depth, not prevention.

Production agents need structured tracing with model version pinning, evaluation 'built into the agentic workflow', LLM-as-a-judge, and governance 'enforced deterministically before actions reach the wire'.

Agent observability means tool-call, reasoning, state-transition and memory-operation spans; online scorers on live traces plus offline golden sets; CI gates that block merges on quality regressions; per-span cost.
AI PM core skills are prototyping with AI coding tools, observability and debugging with traces, and evals ('evals replace traditional PRDs').
The AI PM roadmap lists prompt/context engineering, knowledge systems (RAG), evals and observability, and shipping/hardening as the ladder.

Evaluation and observability is the largest blocker to production (64%); only 38% of production agents run automated evals on every prompt change; 66% red-team public-facing agents before deployment.

Draft NIST AI RMF agentic profile: agent registries with verifiable identity, read/write/execute tool risk classes, a tool-gateway chokepoint, four autonomy tiers, a delegation-lineage accountability register and a kill switch.

survivors.title: Run Scorecard: trajectory and outcome evals with LLM-as-a-judge on every Channel Intelligence run
survivors.use_case: A visitor asks a Channel Intelligence question and, next to the answer, sees a scorecard: did the run take a sensible path (right agents, right tools, no wasted hops), did it reach the goal, and are its citations accurate, each scored 0-1 by an independent judge model with the judge's reasoning readable in the trail.
survivors.skill_set: Agent evaluation: LLM-as-a-judge, trajectory accuracy plus goal completion, eval-driven product management
survivors.deepbench_has: A quality-gate reviewer agent (16 reviews in 30 days) that judges the answer text; the Audit Pipeline Log showing every hop, pattern and citation; ai_activity_log with per-call cost and latency.
survivors.new_work: A scorer that reads the finished run's trace (hops, tool calls, citations) and the answer, produces trajectory, outcome and citation-precision scores with reasons, stores them on the run, and renders a scorecard card in the Audit Pipeline Log; the quality-gate reviewer's verdict becomes one input, not the whole verdict.
survivors.surface: Channel Intelligence run with its reasoning trail (VC-MISSION-031)
survivors.pull_test: VC-ROOT-001 is served because agent evals are the single most-named skill across the Google, Microsoft and Anthropic postings fetched, and a scorecard a visitor can read in 30 seconds shows John scores runs the way those teams do. It is not a standard skill (pattern 149) because trajectory-plus-outcome scoring of a multi-agent run is a 2026 practice most portfolios lack, and not an administrative expectation (pattern 137) because it changes what an evaluator sees on the run.
survivors.enhancement_claim: quality-gate review calls per channel-intelligence answer: up
survivors.scope_rationale: One scorer over the existing trace and one card on the existing log; no new screen, no new agent.
survivors.description: Build a per-run scorecard for Channel Intelligence: after the answer completes, an LLM-as-a-judge call scores trajectory accuracy (were the delegated agents and tools the right ones, were hops wasted), goal completion, and citation precision, each 0.0-1.0 with a one-paragraph reason, persisted on the run and rendered as a card at the top of the Audit Pipeline Log. The existing quality-gate review becomes one scorer input. Serves VC-ROOT-001 and VC-MISSION-031; evidence and ranking in docs/research/2026-09-10-p1-skills-lens.md (survivor 1).

survivors.use_case: Every tool an agent can call carries a risk tier; when a run reaches a write or execute tool, it pauses, records an interruption with the proposed arguments, and waits; the visitor approves or rejects in the Audit Pipeline Log and the run resumes from its checkpoint, with the whole exchange in the trail.

survivors.deepbench_has: Durable multi-hop loops with checkpoints, a generic capability executor, MCP tools, and a work-order screen where side effects happen.

survivors.scope_rationale: Tier column, interruption record and two buttons; checkpoints already exist so resume is a replay, not a rewrite.
survivors.description: Implement human-in-the-loop approvals: tag each tool and capability with a risk tier (read/write/execute); the capability executor pauses before write/execute calls, writes an interruption record with the proposed arguments, and the Audit Pipeline Log renders approve/reject; on approve the durable loop resumes from its checkpoint, on reject the agent receives the refusal as a tool result.
